messages.subject: Campus Drive: Cascade Systems - Senior Software Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Cascade Systems is hiring Senior Software Engineers (CTC 12 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs. Open to placed and unplaced students, subject to your college's one-offer policy.
Register here: https://forms.gle/cascadeSSE by 11:59 PM, 19 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office
